description: AgMIP-Canola collaborators published field observations and crop-model outputs for canola at six sites in five countries. Four spring and three winter cultivars are represented. The deposit includes site and soil characterisation, starting water and nitrogen, daily weather, crop phenology, leaf area, biomass, nitrogen and yield. Ten model-framework outputs cover experimental treatments, while scenario runs vary temperature, rainfall, carbon dioxide and nitrogen using 1981–2010 historical weather. Harvard Dataverse’s public dataset API confirmed the named version 1.0 record and CC0 1.0. DataCite lists compressed, spreadsheet and text files with no price shown. A food-supply modeller can compare canola growth predictions with the field observations or examine climate-adaptation scenarios. These are selected sites, not a worldwide production census; not every variable is measured at each site. The files were not downloaded, so model and observation tables have not been separated in detail. This is related to AgMIP wheat ensembles in G4-0566 and G4-0583 but covers another crop and DOI. The full duplicate scan found no catalogue identity match.
name: Dataset for multi-model comparison and ensemble simulations of canola growth and yield across global sites
